children: On Related Party Disclosure, Governance Issues Our Bureau Mumbai: Adani Group companies have settled legal proceedings with market regulator Sebi by paying a total 1.5 crore in settlement amounts in a case involving alleged related party transaction disclosures and corporate governance issues.
The five companies are Adani Enterprises, Adani Total Gas, AWL Agri Business (formerly Adani Wilmar), Adani Green Energy and Adani Energy Solutions (formerly Adani Transmission).

Under the settlement terms, Adani Enterprises paid 76.05 lakh, while Adani Green Energy paid 45.5 lakh. Adani Total Gas, AWL Agri Business and Adani Energy Solutions each paid 9.75 lakh. The proceedings followed Sebi's examination of allegations relating to related party transactions and corporate governance issues highlighted in the Hindenburg Report.

The examination covered several Adani Group companies and possible violations of Sebi's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations and the erstwhile equity listing agreement. The allegations against Adani Enterprises included non-disclosure of related party transactions between Adani Estates Pvt Ltd, a subsidiary of Adani Enterprises and Vakoder Investment, a related party of Adani Enterprises, in its annual report for FY13.

Adani Enterprises was also alleged to have had audit and limited review reports signed by Dharmesh Parikh & Co LLP without a valid peer review certificate. Further, its limited review reports for the quarters ended June 2017, September 2017 and December 2021 were allegedly signed by Shah Dhandharia & Co LLP without a valid peer review certificate.

Adani Total Gas and AWL Agri Business faced allegations concerning their December 2021 limited review reports being signed by Shah Dhandharia & Co LLP without a valid peer review certificate. In Adani Green Energy's case, Sebi alleged that its audit report for FY19 and limited review reports for the quarters ended September 2018, December 2018 and June 2019 were signed by Dharmesh Parikh & Co LLP without a valid peer review certificate. Adani Energy Solutions faced a similar allegation concerning its limited review report for the quarter ended June 2015.

title: Adani Cos Settle with Sebi, Pay 1.5 crore
